create_valid_python_identifier: create a valid Python identifier from a string with special characters and keywords
clean_backtick_quoted_toks: clean up a backtick-quoted token by converting it to a valid Python identifier
clean_column_name: clean a column name by tokenizing it inside backticks and removing special characters
split_by_backtick: split a source string by backticks while respecting single and double quoted strings
tokenize_string: tokenize a Python source string with backtick-quoted identifiers into a sequence of tokens
